notes: Hole height measure (CONTROL, off by default): before each hole the laser reads the plate at the hole centre and the hole is cut at the measured height - turn on in Process Settings > Holes, needs HOLE_MEAS and SLIP_V2 REV4 on the robot. Flush cope clearance is now a setting in NEST and CONTROL; a cope drawn closer to the web than the clearance is held off at the clearance, default 0.5 mm as before. Kjellberg sources get automatic amperage from the cut chart. Flange cuts over a shallow web cope slow to the chart speed for the full depth. German, French and Spanish language packs for both apps (General settings > Language).
